summary: @servicetitan/time-zones ships install-time dropper that downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 720KB payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/` into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to `execFileSync` the sibling file `math_init.js` (or invokes an already-installed Bun if present). `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727KB `// @bun` bundle obfuscated with rotated string-array cipher (`WV8StW` shuffle, `n7gIxM` opcode table with ~1000 entries, mangled identifiers) and is not human-readable. The package is scoped to `@servicetitan` and advertises itself as a React time-zone picker library, a purpose which has no legitimate need for a bundled alternate JavaScript runtime or an opaque install-time payload. The dropper fires automatically on `npm install`, giving arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine under a runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
